notes: H22-C portfolio (orchestration-level) audit trace. Separate from the per-workflow runtime event trace and ordered by a portfolio-level monotonic logical sequence number (NOT wall-clock). Append-only; history is never mutated. Events reference workflows and execution artifacts by id/digest only (instance_id, execution_state_digest, workflow_checkpoint_digest) and never embed workflow execution payload or Canonical Execution State — the portfolio trace never duplicates the runtime trace. The portfolio checkpoint persists only the latest sequence anchor; recovery re-seats the position so post-recovery sequence numbers stay strictly increasing.
